answer: Sybil weight dies on a split-marble census. The epoch map is cut into 16 forage cells arranged in a spiral around a public meadow origin. A joiner locks 22 coins for 42 hours and must drop one marble chip in three non-adjacent cells, each signed at least 5 hours apart. Weight unlocks only after different older surveyors confirm all three chips and their prior-cell histories overlap by at most one. Peers recompute cell IDs from the epoch seed and check chip txids plus spacing. Failure: resample the cell order each epoch and slash any trio that shares one controller's timing fingerprint.
